name: Kenya-wide benchmark of DEM flat resolution for QEHT
description: Derived results of a stratified benchmark of D8 flat resolution on 80 tiles across Kenya (20 per terrain class), each routed on ALOS AW3D30 and FABDEM V1-2 at their native 1″ grids. Methods compared: QEHT toward-lower, QEHT Barnes et al. (2014), a weighted hybrid, TauDEM, RichDEM, MAS Spatial Analysis Tool 1.2.1 and DDM HydroLogic 2.3. The archive contains the sampling frame (2,360 eligible tiles), per-run metrics for all 160 runs (stream F1 and IoU, basin and flat-direction agreement, flow loops, timings), summary statistics, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure in the accompanying paper. DEM clips are not included for licensing reasons; they can be recut from the tile bounds in the sampling frame.
